description: Official Nepal Rastra Bank exchange rates (NPR buy/sell per currency) for any day since 2000, AD or BS date, with amount conversion and up to 31-day series. Use for Nepali rupee (NPR) exchange rates or conversions: today's or a past day's official rate, converting an amount to or from NPR, or a rate series. Returns rate {buy, sell, mid, unit}, conversion {nprAtBuy, nprAtSell, nprAtMid}, the full table rates[] when no currency is given, series[] for a range, and rateDate (the table actually used; holidays fall back to the previous day). Price: $0.001 per call from Exepal credit; not charged if the call fails. Includes free daily calls.

amount.description: With currency: amount to convert to NPR (also returns the reverse)

currency.description: ISO 4217 code to return alone, e.g. USD, INR, EUR, AED. Omit for the full table

date.description: Day to quote, AD (2026-10-31) or BS (2083-07-14); default today in Nepal. Holidays fall back to the last published table

from.description: Start date for a series (max 31 days before date); requires currency

name: south_asia_forex

cached.description: Present and true when the answer came from Exepal's cache

fallback.description: True when NRB published nothing that day and the previous table was used

buyPerUnit.description: NPR for 1 unit of the currency

unit.description: NRB quotes some currencies per 10 or 100 units

rates.description: Whole table, when no currency was sent
